'''Raynar Cath''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|As I was saying, there are two high priority targets in this mining cave that Nym would like... Lets just say, they wouldn't be missed.|Mako Ghast, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MtM" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Raynar Cath worked in a [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|mining facility]] operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During that time, Cath and [[Wes Riggers]], another miner, meddled in the affairs of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], the most powerful criminal organization on Lok and provoked the ire of their leader: the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]].<ref name="SWG:MtM" />
[[File:Imperial_Mine_Lok.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial Mine]].]]

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the miners hit a gas pocket, releasing toxic vapors in the mine. The gas did not physically injured the miners but made them crazy and very aggressive. The situation in the mine was later discovered by the Lok Revenants. [[Jinkins]], Nym's chief engineer, thus decided to obtain a sample of the gas in order to study it and use it as a weapon if possible.<ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Jinkins|Lok}}</ref> Jinkins thus tasked a group of adventurous [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] of the Lok Revenants with retrieving a sample of toxic gas.<ref name="SWG:RtMF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Mine Filter|Lok}}</ref> While Jinkins was preparing the assault, [[Mako Ghast]], another lieutenant of Nym, realized that the raid on the mine could be an opportunity to get rid of Riggers and Cath.<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> The Lok Revenants then raided the Imperial mine and retrieved a sealed container of the poisonous gas for Jinkins.<ref name="SWG:RtMF" /> During the assault, the spacers attacked and killed both Wes Riggers and Raynar Cath.<ref name="SWG:MtM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raynar Cath was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Raynar Cath was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:MtM" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
